law.catch_line: Annual budget; reserves for capital components

text.section: Except to the extent provided in the declaration, the board of directors shall, prior to the commencement of the fiscal year, make available to lot owners either (i) the annual budget of the association or (ii) a summary of such annual budget.

Except to the extent otherwise provided in the declaration, the executive board shall:
Conduct at least once every five years a study to determine the necessity and amount of reserves required to repair, replace, and restore the capital components as defined in § 55.1-2100;
Review the results of that study at least annually to determine if reserves are sufficient; and
Make any adjustments the executive board deems necessary to maintain reserves, as appropriate.
